sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man slightly toward screen left with dark hair, brows, short dark moustache and shaped jaw/chin beard. White peaked naval cap with black band, ornate gold crest/red center and gold visor embroidery. Navy lapelled uniform/light blue pointed shirt/navy tie. Serious closed mouth, full pale grey-beige backing; retain cap/beard and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man toward screen right with white brows/short white moustache and neat white beard. White peaked naval cap with dark band/gold crest/red center/gold visor band. Dark navy lapelled coat/light blue shirt/dark tie. Gentle closed mouth, full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve cap, beard, pose/light and short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man slightly toward screen left with short dark hair greying at temples, heavy brows and stern closed mouth. Dark navy piped-lapel suit, pale grey pointed shirt, dark red tie and small gold hammer-and-sickle lapel pin at viewer right. Full pale grey-beige backing; preserve pin, clothing and compact broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man slightly toward screen left with short dark hair greying at sides and strong brows. Dark navy jacket with pale lapel piping, grey shirt and blue bow tie; no visible pin. Restrained closed mouth, close bust/full pale grey-beige backing; preserve hair, bow, pose/light and broad short neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man turned slightly screen left with short dark hair/grey temples, strong brows and stern closed mouth. Dark olive army coat with pale seam edging and small round silver shoulder buttons over light grey pointed shirt and dark olive tie. Full pale grey-beige backing; preserve uniform variant and short broad shirt fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man facing toward screen left with short receding dark hair greying at sides, dark brows and restrained closed mouth. Brown army jacket with small gold shoulder badges and US-shaped lapel marks, beige pointed shirt and dark navy tie. Full pale grey-beige backing; retain badges without invented tiny text, original pose/light and broad short neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man with thick wavy dark brown hair greying subtly at sides, heavy brows and serious closed mouth. Brown military coat/gold collar marks and small shoulder details, beige pointed shirt/dark tie. Upper-lip shadow is not clearly a moustache, so add no beard. Full pale grey-beige backing; preserve shading and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man with short side-parted brown hair, dark eyebrows and serious closed mouth. Brown military jacket with small gold US-shaped collar marks and shoulder trim, light khaki pointed shirt/dark tie. No hat/glasses or clearly visible facial hair. Full pale grey-beige backing, close bust and shaded side light; retain uniform and compact broad neck.
